items.hyp: Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o ne a sa lebelela gore go tlhagelela go tswa mo go tshimologong go tlaa tswelela moletlo wa kgwedi ya Labotlhano go ya kwa kgweding ya Labone, mme go tlaa tswelela go tswa mo go tshimologong mo lefelong la dikgwebo, lefelo la dikgwebo le lefelo la dikgwaobogolo.
